title: MySQL integrated pipeline: deleting it drops its destination tables

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: MySQL 8.4.13, serverless, two tables

symptom: The destination tables were not found 1 s after the integrated pipeline was deleted (TABLE_OR_VIEW_NOT_FOUND). A pipeline recreated on the same source tables created new tables whose Delta history starts at version 0.
cause: Not established. The pipeline may own its streaming tables.
effect: The destination data goes with the pipeline.
fix: Copy the destination tables out before the delete.
notes: The entry expected the tables to stay. Possibly intended; check the public docs on deleting a pipeline.
